publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: Data in the company are the base and also product of all done procedures, on one side the commercial, on the other side the contact with public administration. Data are associated into the documents which come through several phases of the life cycle according to the organization's needs. The organization handles with the documents (digital or analogue) and in connection to it there might appear some questions: Is the digital document equal to the analogue? How to keep digital documents so that they will be readable for all its life cycle? How to secure digital documents against changing (also not wanted), against falsification or damage? The legislation also influence the companies behavior, which means the influence how the documents are dealt with. Legislative definition is solved at the national levels, but also within the EU, where the effort is to set the environment for electronic trust services. The aim of this text is to chart the present situation about handling with documents in the company, especially the documents archiving, to show the problematic aspects and to describe also possible ways of solution.

articleTitle: Battery Degradation impact on the Electric Bus Fleet Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: In this paper we deal with the battery degradation process and its possible impact on the scheduling of the electric bus fleet in the public transport system. The scheduling problem is quite well known and researched. Although, the nature of electric buses changes the base of problem due to the limited driving range and longer charging time in comparison to the conventional buses. Also, the battery goes through degradation process during the operation, which means its capacity is slowly reduced. From this reason the scheduling of the buses must be redone to preserve the service of all the trips. We model the scheduling problem as a mixed integer linear problem and solve it to optimality by a standard IP solver Xpress Ive. Our main goal is to investigate, how the solution and computation time changes with different maximum capacity of the battery. The performance is tested on datasets created from public transport system in Zilina.

articleTitle: Importance Analysis of Multi-State System Based on Incompletely Specified Data by Multi-Valued Decision Diagrams
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: The evaluation of system reliability is implemented by the set of reliability indices and measures. Every of them reflects specific properties of system reliability. Importance measures are group of reliability indices that show influence of state change of fixed component to system reliability. There are many algorithms to calculate these indices. These algorithms are developed for completely specified data. In many cases, not all information about analyzed system is available. In this paper new method for calculation of Importance Measures based on incompletely specified data. This method is based on the definition of analyzed system mathematical model in form of structure function that defines the correlation of system reliability and its components states. The structure function is represented by Multi-Valued Decision Diagram (MDD). MDD is inducted by the algorithm that is used for the decision tree induction based on incompletely specified data. Available data of system are used in order to build decision tree. The decision tree is transformed into MDD. MDD allows calculation Importance Measures. In this paper the developed method is used to analyze dataset of patients with hepatitis in reliability point of view, specifically Structure Importance was calculated for each component.

articleTitle: Improving Fuzzy C-Means Algorithm using Particle Swarm Optimization and Fuzzy C-Means++
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: The aim of the paper is to improve fuzzy particle swarm optimization. Our modification consists of modifying the hybrid fuzzy particle swarm optimization by replacing the random initialization of centers in the c-means fuzzy section with the FCM++ algorithm. We experimentally compared our modification with other nature-inspired meta-heuristic algorithms for fuzzy clustering.

articleTitle: Deep Embedded Clustering for Data-Driven ECG Exploration Using Continuous Wavelet Transforms
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: Due to the length, complexity, and inter-subject variation of physiological signals acquired non-invasively, datadriven analysis is increasingly valuable in Smart Health, precision medicine, and in studying physiological dynamics. Knowledge discovery in medical research requires that domain experts analyze complex, high-dimensional data and signals, which is facilitated by dimensionality reduction and clustering. The current paper presents an unsupervised machine learning approach to clustering time-frequency features from ECG records using deep embedded clustering, which optimizes a clustering metric that maps high-dimensional time-frequency data to a lower dimensional latent space. These clusters can be obtained in arbitrarily low dimensions, and are subsequently analyzed with visual analytics to uncover structures and patterns. This technique is applied to time segments of continuous wavelet transforms of ECG records, representing a variety of conditions. Preliminary results on publicly-available ECG records indicate that deep embedded clustering produces a low-dimensional learned representation of time-frequency characteristics that facilitates signal exploration and improves interpretability.

articleTitle: A Conceptual Project for the organisation of Road Traffic Crash and Road Traffic Crash Casualty Data acquisition for Research Purposes
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: Objectives. Enhancing police road traffic crash records with road traffic crash related data from other sources is of special importance. One of such sources are data on casualties' harm. However, it is time consuming to collect non-police data on casualties' harm, especially from scattered and structurally heterogeneous data resources. Thus, the objective of the work was to elaborate the concept of an appropriately organised central data acquisition system that refers to road crashes. After implementation, the system could support both road traffic safety research and road traffic safety decision making purposes. Methods. The investigation has been conducted taking into account the need of research on road traffic safety in which information from external road traffic crash casualty data sources and police databases are linked. It enabled drawing the conclusion that record-level road crash casualty data from multiple providers are generally not organised and accessible at a national level. In order to address a possible solution to the problem, in the work a systematic approach was used, in which selected elements of the system analysis were adopted. The component parts (subsystems) of the central data acquisition system and their possible interactions were identified and examined. Then, the system requirements and constraints were discussed. Results. The scheme of the central system has been elaborated, the organisation of which would make the provision of both road crash data from police and road crash casualty data from administratively diverse units possible for any stakeholders. A diagram of the data transfer was described and a selection of key fields for the data integration was proposed. As the whole issue has a country-specific nature, the approach was presented for Polish conditions. Conclusions. Essential aspects of interdisciplinary research problems were identified and investigated with reference to the solution to the problem of how to agilely organise a central system of the data acquisition and the data access for road traffic safety analyses. The approach could initiate similar discussion and activities in other countries.

articleTitle: Definition of Agent Goals by Means of Missions
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: Agent based simulation is often the preferred method utilized to investigate properties of complex systems. Vital part of definition of agent based models is the definition of goals agents have to fulfil. Declarative way of specifying these goals is easy to implement, however such approach limits the reusability of defined goals. The paper proposes agent missions, which are defined in the form of a graph that is interpreted during simulation run. Proposed approach provides universal means to define agent goals in various types of models and allows easy definition of parallelization and synchronization of defined goals. Basic algorithms of mission interpreter, which can be incorporated into managing agent's logic, are presented as well. We show that missions can be defined independently from agent's reasoning engine and agent relationship structure, which further extends the applicability of proposed approach.

articleTitle: To the Creation of an Automated System of Emergency and Abnormal Modes Diagnosis for the Mobile Robotic Trolley based on Fuzzy Behavior Charts
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: The article considers the issue of creating an automated system for diagnosing the abnormal and emergency operation modes of mobile industrial robotic trolleys based on fuzzy behavior charts.From the carried out subject area analysis, it could be made a decision that the chosen research topic is actual, taking into account the development pace of mobile robotics and the importance of using diagnostics of the functioning for various automated systems.Development of a system for diagnosing abnormal and emergency situations based on fuzzy behavior charts for a controlled mobile robotic trolley involves the sequential implementation of certain steps that are discussed in the article. The object of diagnostics was decomposed into nodes, where disturbing factors and output variables were determined. There were created four models of mobile trolleys in the form of fuzzy behavior charts, which are necessary for the further implementation of the automated system for diagnosing abnormal and emergency situations.

articleTitle: Estimate Train Driving Time with Artifical Inteligence
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: The main goal of this paper is to analyze properties of train set due to driving time with the use of machine learning. The implementation of the regression machine learning model is done using the framework ML.NET in the programming language C#. The beginning of the thesis is dedicated to a theoretical overview about machine learning and an introduction to the framework ML.NET. Then we will use the aforementioned framework to achieve the best results while predicting the driving time of trains. We need to analyze the data set before attempting to implement the model. The process of detect missing data and making a strategy about is also done before implementing the model. This process is followed by finding the list of train features, which greatly affect the final predicted driving time of the train. In conclusion we evaluate the acquired results and the pros and cons of implementing a machine learning model in the programming language C# using the framework ML.NET.

articleTitle: Analyze Train Data Set with use of Linear Regression and Cloud Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: The aim of this bachelor thesis is to compare the suitability of solution of cluster systems in the analysis of train set properties, which influence the driving time of the train. Study of the necessary machine learning knowledge and analysis of available cloud systems. Furthermore, we will introduce the possibility of implementation on cloud systems. We will implement the calculation of the train driving time, based on the characteristics of the train set on the cloud systems. Then we compare and evaluate the results.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Identification of the Skin Surface Temperature caused by the Temperature of Tissue inflammation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: Purpose - The main goal is to identify the skin surface temperature in the steady state. Since two types of equations (Laplace and Helmholtz) are considered, it is necessary to derive the Trefftz functions (T-functions) for the Helmholtz equation in the cylindrical system of coordinates (whereas for the Laplace equation they are known).Design/methodology/approach - Approximate solutions of two problems are expressed in the form of linear combination of the T-functions with unknown coefficients. For each problem, minimizing the functional that describes the matching of an approximate solution to the boundary conditions leads to a system of algebraic equations for these coefficients.Findings/novelty - T-functions for the Helmholtz equation are derived. An infinite set of these functions is a complete set of functions. Approximate solutions for temperature of skin surface caused by inflammation are determined both when perfusion is and is not taken into account.Research implications - The method presented in the paper is simpler than the ones used in the literature. The applied method always leads to results that fit the physics of the problem described by the used governing equation.Originality/value - The T-functions for the Helmholtz equation in cylindrical coordinates have been reported in this paper for the first time. The results are discussed with respect to practical applications.

articleTitle: An Age Based Maintenance Policy Model for Unavailability Analysis of Dormant Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: Repairable systems with latent failures are systems where special inspections are realized regularly, with a fixed period, to reveal a failure. If a failure is revealed, the renewal procedure is started at the earliest possible inspection time. Maintenance policies for such systems can be categorized into two main classes: age based and calendar based policies. In the age based policy we suppose that maintenance actions are realized at a given time interval starting from the latest time of maintenance, whereas in the calendar based policy, the system inspections and maintenance are realized periodically at planned times known in advance. In the age based policy, real calendar time of maintenance actions is unknown in advance, due to random times of failures and random times necessary for restorations. Relevant issue of the paper is to formulate reliability mathematics describing the time based maintenance policy model, here denoted as Model III. The paper results from innovative stochastic reliability models, recently developed and used for unavailability quantification of repairable and maintained systems with latent failures. Models are transformed into numerical codes to be demonstrated on both a referenced simple system with the Weibull ageing and real complex system from practice. For the reason of system unavailability analyses, the directed acyclic graph was used in this study, which showed to be a suitable system representation of complex systems.

Author Keywords: unavailability quantification; alternating renewal process; directed acyclic graph

articleTitle: Validation of Bulk Properties of Red Blood Cells in Simulations
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: In a simulation model used to optimize microfluidic devices, blood is modeled as a red blood cell suspension using a dissipative version of Immersed Boundary Method (DC-IBM). Red blood cells (RBCs) are represented by elastic objects embedded in the fluid flow. The cell model and its parameters were calibrated to lit real experiment with one cell, such as a stretching experiment [1], or an experiment with red blood cell flowing through a narrowed channel [2]. For the correctnes of the model it is necessary to maintain the bulk properties of the blood flow. To validate the model, we investigated the hemodynamic phenomenon occurring in the narrower vessels, specifically the formation of a cell-free layer (CFL). The blood flow in the microchannel is simulated with hematocrit values in the range of 5-15% with cells with varying degrees of deformability. The results confirm existence of the migration from the channel walls to the center, resulting in the formation of CFLs near the walls. In accord with biological experiments, we confirmed a decrease in CFL thickness with increasing hematocrit. The effect of cell deformability on CFL and cell trajectory was also examined. This may be useful for further statistical analysis or model validation.

articleTitle: Toward Generation of Dependability Assessment Models for Industrial Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: This article focuses on the development of a tool-based approach for the assessment of industrial control IT systems. The originality of the approach relies in two main points. First of all, the underlying formal models for dependability assessment must cover dynamic behavior of the IT architectures to take into account reparation, reconfiguration and modes in the life cycle of the architecture. Secondly, these formal models must be automatically established and hidden to the architecture designers to reduce time consumption when dealing with a large amount of candidate architectures evaluated during the engineering phase. This work is a first step towards such an objective by defining a structured UML (Unified Modelling Language) modelling framework for identifying and structuring the key objects of an architecture with regard to dependability.

articleTitle: Usefulness of the Single Period of a Periodic Signal to assessment a Human Voice Stability
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: A method for evaluating the stability of the voice by analysing individual single period of a periodic signal had been described in this paper. The assessment of the stability of the human voice is of great importance in speech therapy, neurology, as well as in voice-controlled systems and public security. The duration of this oscillation is contained within a few milliseconds. The objective of the study was defined as the evaluation of the stability of the human voice with the use of Fourier transforms. The biggest problem was the breakdown of the recording to the smallest unit in such a way as to division method in a minimal way has affected the final results. Subsequently a preponderance the methods for assessing the stability of voice based on the FFT had been revealed. The results were compared to those obtained on a standard way, with using a statistical analysis, and conclusions were formed concerning the usefulness of this method.

articleTitle: Optimal management of Supply Chain: Modeling of Decision Rules
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: In this paper the problem of dynamic inventory operation management is considered. To show the current needs of enterprises, the theoretical information on the development trends of industry and enterprise information systems in retrospect to the present day are presented. At the same time, the enterprise vision and demands placed on it in the digitization era are pictured. The research carried out has shown that the tools supporting the decision-making process are required nowadays. Bearing in mind the constantly changing environment of enterprises, it was recognized that optimal control methods are the most adequate for modeling decision rules. The main goal of this paper is to formulate and find the numerical solution for an abstract problem of minimizing the costs of inventory maintenance using the optimal control method.

articleTitle: The use of Survival Analysis to investigate Risk Factors for Anastomotic leak
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: In this paper we discuss a way, how to analyze time until the occurrence of anastomotic leak. The main goal of this study is to find risk factors for time until the occurrence of anastomotic leak. Our approach is based on an application of survival analysis and nonparametric predictive inference. This analysis has been implemented by the software R.

articleTitle: Quantitative Requirement Evaluation for a European Refugee Management System serving conflicting Needs of Migrants, GOs, and NGOs in correct and fair operative Form
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information and Digital Technologies (IDT)
abstract: The so-called "refugee crisis" in 2015 overstrained the European authorities and people seeking for help. Many refugee camps in Europe were not adequately prepared and had to process a large number of people. There was no standardized way to handle and coordinate people within a refugee camp. The EU Member States defined different approaches to identify and register refugees on their territory. The authors already proposed a standardized refugee management system concept that should enhance the identification and registration process in a European refugee camp. They introduced 14 functional requirement areas and evaluated them through qualitative research with experts and national authorities. Due to ethical and organizational issues, the authors decided to apply a quantitative survey about the acceptance of the proposed system requirements, which are presented in this paper. Several national and European institutions, companies, and scientists who are involved in the refugee administration should demonstrate the practicability of the proposed system. The results of the survey affirmed the general acceptance of all requirement areas. Furthermore, the authors analyzed the given answers in more detail to understand why specific branches accepted or declined the requirement areas.
